Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely hypothesized that the competition was the Sanremo Music Festival in 2013 based on the album release year (2011) and a general search result, without verifying if Sergio Dalma actually participated in that specific competition. This hypothesis was never confirmed by the WebSurfer; instead, the WebSurfer repeatedly returned results showing Dalma's involvement in Sanremo 2012 (as a guest/duet) or general festival pages without confirming his 2013 participation. The Planner failed to recognize that the search results were inconclusive regarding the 2013 hypothesis and continued to issue redundant instructions to search for the same 2013/2012 queries without adapting the strategy or concluding the task based on the available evidence (which pointed to 2012). This led to a loop of redundant searches and a failure to provide a definitive answer.
